name: inbox-warden
description: Let Claude search, read, sort and draft your email: Gmail, Microsoft 365, GMX, Web.de, IONOS, iCloud or your own mail server.
long_description:
Connects Claude to one mailbox over IMAP and SMTP.

**What Claude can do** depends on the permissions you grant: *read* (search, read, attachments), *write* (sort into folders, flag, create reply drafts), *send* (send email, each send confirmed by you unless you choose otherwise) and *delete* (move to Trash).

**Sign-in:** password or app password, or Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace sign-in in your browser — choose the sign-in method, then ask Claude "please sign me in".

**Files:** Claude reads attachments to send only from folders you choose, and saves attachments only into the folder you choose.

**Locked folders:** folders you name (e.g. for mail under an NDA) are invisible to Claude, including their subfolders.

**Safe by default:** Claude can read and prepare drafts; you send them from your mail program. Nothing is ever selected by guesswork: if a search or folder cannot be matched exactly, the action fails instead of touching more mail. Email content is screened for prompt-injection attempts. Passwords are stored encrypted by Claude Desktop, sign-ins in your operating system's keychain.

Several mailboxes or a server with a self-signed certificate: install the command-line version instead (see Documentation).

email.title: Email address / E-Mail-Adresse
email.description: The mailbox Claude may use, e.g. office@your-company.at.

auth_method.title: Sign-in method / Anmeldung
auth_method.description: password (default): password or app password. microsoft: Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online (preview, needs the OAuth client ID from your administrator), you sign in in the browser — afterwards ask Claude "please sign me in". google: Google Workspace with your organisation's own OAuth client.

password.title: Password or app password / Passwort oder App-Passwort
password.description: Needed for sign-in method password. Gmail, Yahoo and iCloud require an app password (see the guide). Stored encrypted by Claude Desktop, never in a file. Leave empty for microsoft or google.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth client ID (Microsoft 365 / Google)
oauth_client_id.description: The application (client) ID your administrator gives you. Required for google and microsoft. Leave empty for password sign-in.

oauth_tenant.title: Microsoft 365 tenant
oauth_tenant.description: Microsoft 365 only and optional: your organisation's domain (e.g. firma.at) or directory ID, if your administrator asks for it.

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth client secret (Google only)
oauth_client_secret.description: Google Workspace only: the client secret of your organisation's OAuth client. Stored encrypted by Claude Desktop.

display_name.title: Your name / Ihr Name
display_name.description: Shown to recipients as the sender, e.g. Maximilian Achleitner. Optional.

username.title: Login name (only if different) / Benutzername
username.description: Leave empty when you log in with your email address (almost all providers).

imap_host.title: Incoming mail server (IMAP)
imap_host.description: Leave empty to detect it from your address. Only needed for your own or an unusual provider, e.g. imap.example.com.

imap_port.title: IMAP port
imap_port.description: Leave empty for automatic (993 with encryption).

smtp_host.title: Outgoing mail server (SMTP)
smtp_host.description: Leave empty to detect it from your address, e.g. smtp.example.com.

smtp_port.title: SMTP port
smtp_port.description: Leave empty for automatic (465; Microsoft 365 uses 587).

skip_server_lookup.title: Do not look up server settings online
skip_server_lookup.description: Empty server fields are detected from your address: DNS and Mozilla's autoconfig service see your domain, never your password. Turn this on to forbid the lookups and enter the servers yourself.

attachment_dirs.title: Folders Claude may attach files from / Ordner für Anhänge
attachment_dirs.description: Optional. Claude can attach files to drafts only from these folders (and their subfolders). Leave empty to switch file attachments off.

download_dir.title: Folder for saved attachments / Ablageordner
download_dir.description: Optional. Claude saves email attachments only into this folder. Leave empty to switch saving off.

permissions.title: What Claude may do / Was Claude darf
permissions.description: Comma-separated: read (search and read), write (sort, flag, create drafts), send (send email), delete (move to Trash). Recommended: read,write — Claude prepares drafts, you send them.

send_mode.title: Sending / Versand
send_mode.description: Only used when 'send' is allowed above. confirm = Claude asks you before every email (recommended); direct = no extra question; drafts-only = never send.

locked_folders.title: Folders Claude must not see / Ordner, die Claude nicht sehen darf
locked_folders.description: Optional, e.g. for mail under an NDA. Folder names separated by commas, e.g. _NDA_Inbox, _NDA_Project. Subfolders are locked too. Wildcards work: _NDA_* locks every folder whose name starts with _NDA_. For a folder inside another one, write the path with /, e.g. Projects/_NDA_Inbox. Leave empty to lock nothing.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: de or en: language of quote lines ("Am … schrieb …"), sign-in pages and messages.
